items.title: Peace Test Announce New Album Repercussion: Hear “Total Power”
items.summary: The city of Providence, Rhode Island has a proud history of vast, violent, unhinged music, and Peace Test fit right into that. Peace Test aren't in the same experimental freak mode as, say, Lightning Bolt or Dropdead. Instead, they play fearsome, guttural, classic-style hardcore, but they crank the speed and intensity to extreme levels that we rarely see these days.

items.title: DJ Sabrina The Teenage DJ – “Still Standing”
items.summary: In December, DJ Sabrina The Teenage DJ dropped her highly anticipated four-hour album Fantasy. The prolific London-based electronic artist returned in March with the eight-minute house exploration "HeartsDesires," and just last week she shared re-mixed, re-engineered, and re-mastered versions of her old LPs Makin' Magick and Witchkraft. Now, she's back with "Still Standing," which has sort of been in the making for a decade.
